question: What inner measure is declared for the linga, O foremost twice-born?
premises: A measure is declared for the linga
This measure relates to the inner dimension
inference: The inner measure is declared to be of thirty-six units.
uncertainties: garbhamānaṃ may refer to sanctum measure or core measure of the linga
plain_english: O foremost twice-born, the inner measure is declared as thirty-six.
